precommitted_interpretation_checks: Gross revenue falls -132 USD million Q3 minus Q2: Capital Access +19, Financial Technology -7, Market Services -144, Other 0. This is a gross segment accounting bridge, not a causal explanation of demand.

Net revenue after transaction-based expenses rises +9 USD million while gross revenue falls -132. The implied transaction-expense magnitude falls 784 to 643, -141. Do not report net revenue as if it were gross revenue or assert all four segment gross lines explain the net change.

Operating expenses fall -9, so operating income rises +18: net revenue +9 minus expense change -9. Net income attributable to Nasdaq falls -29; selected operating lines do not explain the below-operating/tax bridge.
The source also contains non-GAAP solutions and adjusted results; none is substituted for the selected GAAP statement lines.
Two adjacent quarters do not prove durability, valuation or a trading conclusion.
